title: Multi-step move choice
description: Choose the next hop, move or plan step in a graph, game or multi-step search

situation.description: the whole state text: goal, current node and content, visited set, board

question.description: e.g. 'Which legal move should X play now?'

legal_moves.description: code owns legality; only these can be returned

combine: tie if move.p < tie_p; beam if move.p < follow_p; move otherwise
limitations: small graphs with explicit cues; beam and depth-N planning unmeasured; think latency 3-20 s and not reproducible
the caller owns legality, the visited set and the loop cap; goal_reached (stop) is a `yes_no` call, so `stop` is never returned here
pass read_options think (e.g. 512) for inherently sequential puzzles; with confidence in 0.5-0.8 the engine re-reads once with think 512 and samples 4
notes: # deviation: spec 5.23: the state is one caller-composed text (situation) with legal_moves as an array; goal_claim and the stop decision are not built (stop is listed but unreachable); beam is returned when the re-read still has p < 0.8, the code picks the beam
